scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I wanted to know what type of loan product I was approved for.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan product you were approved for is a Conventional:First Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Could you please tell me the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan? Also, I was wondering if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 6.875%. The total loan costs are $4,328.75. The loan does not have a high-cost mortgage classification, and it does not include negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae. Your debt-to-income ratio is 48%.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. I appreciate your help.

<Very Satisfied> - The agent was polite, knowledgeable, and provided all the information I needed in a clear and concise manner. I feel confident about the loan process and the terms.
